messages:
Ajay: Heads-up — demo on Tue 14:00 PT needs a 6x A100 slot in us-west2 for ~90m. Anyone seen capacity in vendor pool?
Katie: Oof — vendor quota looked tight last check. Which SKU exactly? a100-40g or a100-80g?
Ajay: a100-40g. Demo can tolerate h100 if the latency is similar. Prefer same region though.
Maria: On the ticket we had 4x confirmed for the week, not 6. I'll ping VendorOps.
VendorOps: Hi — we have a soft hold of 4x a100-40g in us-west2. Next inbound shipment ETA Fri 18:00 PT, firming up with carrier. Could free 2x by swapping from a reserved demo window if approved.
Ajay: Can we do a quick swap? Demo is high priority for marketing. If swap needs PO update, loop in procurement.
ProcurementBot: PO# 4521 is open for that vendor. Need procurement approval to reassign 2 units to the demo project. Approvers: Maria, Finance.
Maria: Approving now, but need confirmation from Oncall about eviction risk during the demo.
Oncall: Eviction risk low if we use reserved pool; if we fall back to spot blend there's ~15% preempt risk. Recommend we enable cross-region fallback to us-east1 as plan B.
Katie: Cross-region will add ~30-40ms p99 for the demo's profile. Is that acceptable to PM?
Ajay: PM says acceptable for a demo as long as it's transparent. We'll add a banner saying 'may run from us-east1'.
VendorOps: OK — holding 2x for swap; will release to demo once Proc updates PO and we get the canary tag. Use tag `demo-2026-03-24` in terraform.
Ajay: Terraform snippet I'll use:
```
module "demo_pool" {
  source = "redwood/gpu-pool"
  count  = 6
  sku    = "a100-40g"
  tags   = ["demo-2026-03-24", "marketing-demo"]
}
```
Maria: Thumbs up. Filing the PO update now.
ProcurementBot: PO updated -> 4521 reassigned 2 units to project DEMO-MKT. Invoice holds: none.
Oncall: I've added a canary alert rule for the demo job. If p95 increases >200ms for 3 consecutive minutes, we'll auto-fallback to us-east1 variant.
Katie: Also pinging infra-qa to run a quick smoke once allocation completes.
Ajay: Thanks all — if anyone hits blocking issues ping me directly. :thumbsup:
VendorOps: Will confirm once slots are live (should be within 45m after PO).
